description: Decision-feedback equalizer: normalized LMS over forward and feedback taps (conventions: Synchronization, Decision-feedback equalizer).

cases.source: by hand: output 0 decides d = (1+j)/sqrt2 with no power to update; next the regressor is (0, 0, 0; d), so b becomes d conj(d)/|d|^2 = 1, and from then on the output is d with no error
by hand: with step 0 the forward taps stay a unit impulse and the feedback taps 0, so output n is x[2n] and the error is t_n - x[2n]
